children: Both offerings are expected to close on September 17, 2026.

The transaction is split across two core offerings. The U.S. tranche totals US$1.3B and is issued by Delaware subsidiary TR Finance LLC with full guarantees from Thomson Reuters Corporation and select subsidiaries. It comprises US$800 million of 5.100% notes due 2028 and US$500 million of 5.750% notes due 2033, both paying interest semi-annually.
Interest on the U.S. notes will be payable semi-annually.

Concurrently, TRI will directly issue a C$1B Canadian private placement, fully guaranteed by specified subsidiaries. This placement is structured as C$350M of 4.130% notes due 2029, C$350M of 4.480% notes due 2031, both with semi-annual coupon payments and C$300M of floating rate notes due 2029 that pay interest quarterly at daily compounded CORRA plus 0.76% per annum.
Thomson Reuters plans to deploy the net proceeds from both offerings for general corporate purposes, including the repayment of outstanding debt under its commercial paper program.

title: Thomson Reuters prices $1.3B in U.S. notes alongside C$1B Canadian placement
